title: Passed Pawn Mobility: Blocked vs Unblocked
current_behavior: Janus Classical X22 scores passed pawns strictly by rank without checking advance square control or blockader presence.
search_impact: At slow TC, engine overvalues blockaded passers that cannot advance, underestimating the opponent's blockade strength.
risk_double_counting: Low if tied to empty advance square check.

title: Connected Passers: Mutually Supporting Advancing Pawns
current_behavior: Janus Classical X22 scores b5 and c5 independently as isolated passers, giving zero bonus for mutual defense.
search_impact: Engine fails to realize that connected passers on 5th/6th rank are unstoppable by a lone king or minor piece.
risk_double_counting: Low; passed pawn mask adjacency check is cleanly orthogonal to base passed pawn score.
runtime_cost_est: +1.2% eval latency (computed inside 64K pawn hash, amortized to 0.0% in search).

title: King Safety: Open File with vs without Enemy Attacking Pieces
current_behavior: King shelter evaluates missing pawns in shelter files. Milestone P1.18 Track B penalized open files unconditionally, causing severe regression.
search_impact: Static file penalties cause premature shield pushes unless gated by enemy attacking piece count.
risk_double_counting: High risk of overlap with King Ring Attackers if not carefully structured.

title: Trapped Pieces: Dominated Minor Pieces behind Pawn Chains
current_behavior: Evaluates mobility linearly based on legal pseudo-move count. No discrete trap penalty.
search_impact: Allows bishops to get locked out on a7/h7 or knights on a8/h8 because mobility only drops by 2-3 cp.
risk_double_counting: Moderate overlap with mobility; must only trigger when mobility is strictly zero and piece is cut off.

title: Piece Activity: Passive Weakness Defense vs Active Rook Play
current_behavior: Static pawn penalties (-20 cp) exceed rook mobility increments (+2 to +4 cp), incentivizing passive defense of doomed pawns.
search_impact: In Match 4, X24 passively defended backward pawns, allowing X7's active rooks to dominate.
risk_double_counting: Low; involves adjusting rook 7th rank / open file bonus and endgame mobility weights.
